lines.en: I drag one leg and shuffle along.

lines.zh: 烂泥吸住我的脚，我只能往前拖。
lines.en: Mud swallows my foot; I can only drag it forward.
My ankle rattles; ignore it.
The road is long and my knees slower.
I walk toward the sound.
A piece of me fell on the path.
My shadow moves faster than I do.
Do not come close; I smell awful.
I stop at every step to sniff the air.
My bones are grinding against each other.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙根往阴影里走。
lines.en: I follow the wall into the shade.
I am slow, but I do not stop.

lines.zh: 我站着，听自己肚子里响。
lines.en: I stand and listen to my own gut.
A strip of skin slides off my hand.

lines.zh: 我想不起自己以前是谁。
lines.en: I cannot recall who I used to be.
I lean on a tree and wheeze like a leak.
The maggots count the days for me.
Daybreak makes my eyes ache more.
I raise my hand and a nail falls off.

lines.zh: 我坐在老树桩上，等蛆安静。
lines.en: I sit on an old stump, waiting for the maggots to settle.
I wait for night so I can move faster.

lines.zh: 这具身体越来越不听话。
lines.en: This body obeys me less each day.
You smell of something warm and alive.
I remember what the living look like.
Your eyes, why do they not rot?

lines.zh: 你捂着鼻子，可我还是一直看你。
lines.en: You cover your nose, but I keep watching you.

lines.zh: 我认得你，又好像不认得。
lines.en: I know you, and yet I do not.
Step back; I am holding myself still.
The sound of your breathing is too loud.
I reach out only to touch.
Do you smell of soil as well?
Do not fear me; I only want to follow.
A piece of rotten flesh fell off.
Another piece fell off; never mind.
You broke my arm clean off.
Am I still alive? Apparently so.
Not the head; I still want to walk.
That blow pushed me back two steps.
No blood from the wound, only soil.

lines.zh: 我蹲下去，捡自己的手指。
lines.en: I crouch and pick up my own finger.
The pain reminds me of the day I died.

lines.zh: 你打吧，我一时半会死不了。
lines.en: Keep hitting; I will not die soon.
Food? My tongue rotted away long ago.

lines.zh: 你举着东西，我闻不到甜味。
lines.en: You hold something up; I smell no sweetness.
I'm hungry — but not in the mouth.

lines.zh: 收起来吧，那对死人没用。
lines.en: Put it away; it is useless to the dead.
I only want things that move.

lines.zh: 你递苹果过来，我咬的是你的手。
lines.en: Offer me an apple and it's your hand I bite.

lines.zh: 我追的是声音，不是味道。
lines.en: I follow sound, not flavor.

lines.zh: 那东西在你手里白白浪费。
lines.en: That thing is wasted in your hands.
My stomach stopped working long ago.
Feed me and I still cannot bite.
I bumped you and shed a patch of skin.

lines.zh: 我没站稳，你也别站太近。
lines.en: I lost my balance; do not stand so close.

lines.zh: 我这身骨头，碰一下都响。
lines.en: These old bones rattle at the lightest touch.
Your shoulder is remarkably solid.

lines.zh: 我靠在你身上，就不冷了。
lines.en: Leaning on you, I stop feeling cold.

lines.zh: 对不起，我的手指勾住你了。
lines.en: Sorry, my fingers caught on your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我推开你，是为了忍住不吃。
lines.en: I push you away to keep from biting.

lines.zh: 我们不撞，就这样并排走。
lines.en: Let us not collide; walk beside me instead.
Your warmth is far too strong.

lines.zh: 让开，我刹不住这个身体。
lines.en: Step aside; this body will not brake.
I only thought of that while alive.

lines.zh: 我的身体不会再有孩子。
lines.en: This body will father nothing more.
Wrong question; I died long ago.

lines.zh: 两只僵尸？那只是凑巧同行。
lines.en: Two zombies? We merely walk the same way.
I do not even have a heartbeat left.

lines.zh: 别把我和活着的东西比。
lines.en: Do not compare me with the living.
The only thing I want is quiet.
Such thoughts only make me worse.

lines.zh: 我的骨头经不起那种事。
lines.en: My bones could not survive that.
Find someone else; I only rot.

lines.zh: 我捡起它，指甲留在上面。
lines.en: I pick it up; a nail stays behind.
This smells like someone's old clothes.
I pinch it between two remaining fingers.

lines.zh: 掉了也没关系，我不缺手。
lines.en: If I drop it, fine; I have spare hands.
I tuck it inside my chest to keep.

lines.zh: 这是谁的？我记得这个花纹。
lines.en: Whose is this? I remember this pattern.
I cannot grip it; far too slippery.
The living pick things up; so do the dead.
I carried it for a very long time.
Do not touch; this is my relic.
There is a sound; I turn toward it.
There is a heartbeat behind that door.
That bird calls so sweetly, so loudly.
My jaw is biting on its own.

lines.zh: 谁在墙那边走？我听见了。
lines.en: Who walks beyond the wall? I hear it.
Something living is very close.
The scent has come down the wind.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过身，关节在响。
lines.en: I turn slowly, and my joints creak.
A shadow is moving over there.

lines.zh: 我想起该怎么抓东西了。
lines.en: I remember how to grab things now.
Not yet; let me hear it clearly.
The iron door creaks; something is inside.
I open my hands, and the knuckles crack.

lines.zh: 那个方向，有活人的气味。
lines.en: That direction carries the smell of the living.

lines.zh: 我忘了要做什么，只记得要抓住。
lines.en: I forgot the rest; I only recall grabbing.
I stare at it and close in slowly.
One step, another; do not run.
My head tilts so I can see better.
If it runs, I will follow slowly.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，先闻它的后颈。
lines.en: My head tilts as I sniff the back of its neck.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸停了，它没发现。
lines.en: My breathing stopped; it has not noticed.
My arm rises slower than I intended.
I am waiting for it to come closer.
My eyes are dry, but they still see.

lines.zh: 烂掉的那只手举起来了。
lines.en: My rotting arm is up now.
My groan announces where I am.
A shadow there, shorter than a person.
It smells warm and alive.
I must strike before it turns.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条腿，慢慢挪过去。
lines.en: Dragging a leg, I shuffle closer.
I raise my arm; it wants to move more than I do.

lines.zh: 我在它身后站定，没有出声。
lines.en: I stop behind it without a sound.
It looks back; my head is still crooked.
Got you; do not struggle.
My hands will not stop.

lines.zh: 这一拳，我控制不住力道。
lines.en: I cannot control the force of this swing.
Bone against bone makes a terrible sound.

lines.zh: 你流出来的东西还是热的。
lines.en: What leaks from you is still warm.
I do not hate you; I am simply hungry.

lines.zh: 打完这拳，我手腕脱臼了。
lines.en: That swing dislocated my wrist.

lines.zh: 你叫吧，声音会引来更多。
lines.en: Scream; the sound will bring more of us.
My teeth snapped shut on nothing.
You will end up like me.
I hold you down; my hands are heavy.
Do not run; honestly, I cannot catch you.
Once I smell a wound, I cannot stop.

lines.zh: 抱歉，我生前不是这样的人。
lines.en: Sorry; I was not like this when alive.

lines.zh: 我的指甲在你胳膊上划开一道。
lines.en: My nails open a line down your arm.
I miss, and my arm keeps swinging.

lines.zh: 土松开，我从里面爬出来。
lines.en: The soil loosens and I claw out.

lines.zh: 我出生的第一声，是呻吟。
lines.en: The first sound I make is a groan.
It is too bright; my skin stings.

lines.zh: 我记得这片田，又好像不记得。
lines.en: I remember this field, or perhaps not.
Who buried me so shallowly?

lines.zh: 我站起来，先掉了一只手。
lines.en: I stand up and first lose a hand.
A new body with the same old smell.

lines.zh: 我听见附近还有人在动土。
lines.en: I hear someone else moving earth nearby.
I must find shelter before sunrise.
My bones creak once and settle into place.
Even I am afraid of this face.
Who is crying? I think I know them.

lines.zh: 我从墓地里学会了走路。
lines.en: I learned to walk in a graveyard.
Do not look; I am not steady yet.
Fire catches and my skin curls.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，骨头散了。
lines.en: I fell from a height and my bones scattered.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我还在往下沉。
lines.en: Water pours in and I keep sinking.
The blast left me only half a body.

lines.zh: 一支箭插进我胸口，不疼。
lines.en: An arrow in my chest, and I feel nothing.

lines.zh: 白光一照，我的皮在冒烟。
lines.en: White light hits and my skin smokes.
I am so hungry I cannot walk straight.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我站着抖了很久。
lines.en: Lightning struck and I trembled for a long while.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，我连呻吟都没了。
lines.en: Falling into the void, even my groan stops.
